svg.title: The three lanes of openfarm
svg.desc: Frontier lane: architect pass, card decomposition, review and local merge. Orchestrator lane: claim and eligibility, run every gate, branch and dossier, with an optional bounded micromanager. Farm lane: planner, test writer, implementer and checker, which receive fenced briefs and return edit blocks only.
svg.text: Three lanes, one rule: no model grades its own work
Frontier context holds design and review only. Design target: roughly 3k to 8k tokens.
Budgets, kill switch and circuit breaker enforced in code.

svg.text: Compile loops, retries and counter-tests stay down here, out of frontier context. No shell, no tools.
